findings.page: Your cart - Pine and Peak Outfitters
findings.problem: A newsletter popup appeared on arrival and grabbed keyboard focus into its Email field; I had to guess to press Escape to close it, and focus then dropped to the page heading.
After each page load focus restarts at the top, so I had to tab through the skip link, logo and cart link every time before reaching the form fields.
Country dropdown starts on a placeholder, and picking an option needs arrow keys with no hint; the delivery choice is a radio group where Space is needed to select it, easy to miss.
Add to cart gives no focus change, only a text message that may not be announced; had to shift-tab back to find the Cart link.

findings.page: Your cart - Pine and Peak Outfitters
findings.problem: A newsletter popup appeared on arrival and grabbed keyboard focus into its Email field; I had to guess to press Escape to close it, and focus then dropped to the page heading.
After each page load focus restarts at the top, so I had to tab through the skip link, logo and cart link every time before reaching the form fields.
Country dropdown starts on a placeholder, and picking an option needs arrow keys with no hint; the delivery choice is a radio group where Space is needed to select it, easy to miss.
Add to cart gives no focus change, only a text message that may not be announced; had to shift-tab back to find the Cart link.
